lines.text: "Brother, I love Christ and Him, His dear Son (Ephesians 5:2), just as you do. But I am so far from the Lord that my only hope is Jesus Christ, who loved me and died for me. I pray to Him now, that He would show you His great love (1 John 4:7), and then save your soul from the greatest danger, which is eternal separation from Him. Please step aside so I can go to the Lord for you."
